If you only read three pieces:

  1. design-comments - I closed the commenting gap for coded prototypes. GitHub-backed architecture; PatternFly maintains it.
  2. Red Hat Packages catalog - Shipped to production: unified catalog, faceted IA, one week from audit to deploy.
  3. Published product suite - Store and PWA apps with real users, built with AI-assisted solo development.

For healthcare-adjacent roles, start with ReflectED instead of the suite overview.
